spans.s: प्रफर्वी [prapharvī], Ved. A woman having excellent hips or going in a graceful way; a lewd girl (?).
प्रफुल्त [praphulta], p. p. Blooming, blossomed, full-blown; लोध्रद्रुमं सानुमतः प्रफुल्तम्
Full-blown, blossoming, blooming; न हि प्रफुल्लं सहकारमेत्य वृक्षान्तरं काङ्क्षति षट्पदाली
Expanded or dilated like a full-blown flower (as eyes).
Gay, cheerful, pleased. -Comp. -नयन, -नेत्र, -लोचनa. with eyes expanded with joy. -वदन a. having a beaming or cheerful countenance, looking cheerful.
